title: Header wrapTopAndBottom band pushes the strip's own line under compatibilityMode 15; side-wrapped header drawings are body obstacles
source: hfprobe15.pdf: 8 sections x one header, TNR 12 docDefaults after=0 line=240, compatibilityMode 15, Word for Mac direct PDF, pymupdf first body glyph tops. Portrait A4 pages (top = header dist 48.3pt): C1 picture 75x43.9pt wrapTopAndBottom at paragraph offset -24pt -> body 82.4; C2 offset -70pt / 100pt picture unclamped -> 92.5; C3 offset -60 (wholly above) -> 62.5 (control, unpushed); C4 = C1 with an empty anchor paragraph -> 82.4; C8 offset 0 -> 106.4. Landscape pages C5-C7 (banner wrapTight/wrapSquare, behindDoc or not): body top 72.3 unmoved, lines 1-2 beside the banner. Rendered as body-top deltas against the C3 page

cases.note: C1: band cuts into the line, line + body move below the picture
C2: negative offset not clamped, picture bottom 78.3
C4: empty anchor paragraph pushes the same
C8: offset 0, line below the picture
